test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends, Chandan, Aman, Falak, Manoj, Mahima, Bony and Fatima, are standing in a line facing east but not necessarily in the same order. Chandan is to the immediate right of Fatima. Fatima is fourth to the right of Falak. Manoj is an immediate neighbour of both Aman and Bony. Falak, who is third to the left of Aman, is standing at one of the extreme end.

What is the correct position of Mahima?

options.text: To the immediate left of Chandan
To the immediate left of Bony
Immediate neighbour of Bony and Fatima
Fourth to the right of Manoj

solution: From the given information: Step 1: Falak, who is third to the left of Aman, is standing at one of the extreme ends. Fatima is fourth to the right of Falak. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f127bedaa4ef0b46458f5b0333ca572cc476df21a4ba701a359a9314e26562e3.png] Falak is at the extreme end but Fatima is 4rd to the right of Falak which means Falak has to be at the left end. Step 2: Chandan is to the immediate right of Fatima.
